WITH CustomerTotals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS TotalSpent
    FROM Customer c
    LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId
), Shares AS (
    SELECT CustomerId, TotalSpent,
           TotalSpent / NULLIF(SUM(TotalSpent) OVER (), 0) AS RevenueShare
    FROM CustomerTotals
), AverageShare AS (
    SELECT AVG(RevenueShare) AS AvgShare
    FROM Shares
), AboveAverage AS (
    SELECT s.TotalSpent, s.RevenueShare, a.AvgShare
    FROM Shares s
    CROSS JOIN AverageShare a
    WHERE s.RevenueShare > a.AvgShare
)
SELECT AVG(TotalSpent) AS AverageAmountSpent,
       AVG(RevenueShare) AS AverageShare,
       AVG(RevenueShare - AvgShare) AS AverageShareAboveAverage
FROM AboveAverage
